name: Duobot
tagline: Duobot helps a couple or household stay in sync.
description: Duobot helps a couple or household stay in sync. Each partner has their own Duobot, and both work from one shared Google Calendar and one shared Trello board (To Duo, Duo-ing, Done, Groceries, Bills, Gifts, Date Night, Vacation). Duobot drafts, you approve: nothing is sent, booked, or paid without your say-so. Get the image cards and avatars at duobotsi.com. Stay in sync. Let's Duo it.
author: legallyrenee
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
